decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute because it was opened too late. TXN-008032 (1354.21 EUR, RIVERSIDE GADGETS, card CRD-000168) posted on 2026-05-26. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 150 days later. Policy section time-limits allows 120 days from posting and says a later dispute is declined, even when the transaction has fraud indicators. The authorisation AUTH-008229 was an online payment with no 3-D Secure check and the fraud flag set. Without the time limit, that would normally count as unauthorised, but the time limit is checked first and decides the case.

proposed_actions.reason: Your dispute was opened 150 days after the payment posted to your account on 2026-05-26. Disputes have to be opened within 120 days of the posting date, so we cannot accept this one.
